meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析科学数据文件（如基因序列、显微镜图像、表格等），自动识别文件类型，检查数据质量，并生成一份 Markdown 格式的报告，包含数据概况、统计结果和后续分析建议。
howto.when: 当用户提供科学数据文件的路径，或要求“探索/分析/总结”某个数据文件，或想了解数据结构与质量时触发。

say.note: Claude 会识别 FASTQ 格式并生成 EDA 报告。

say.text: 探索 experiment_results.csv，看看有没有缺失值
say.note: Claude 会检查缺失值并给出统计摘要。

say.text: 帮我总结 cells.nd2 图像的基本信息
say.note: Claude 会读取图像元数据并报告维度与通道信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze scientific data files (e.g., sequences, images, tables), detect file type, check quality, and produce a Markdown report with data summary, stats, and suggested next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a path to a scientific data file, asks to explore/analyze/summarize a file, or wants to assess data structure and quality.

say_en.note: Claude will identify FASTQ and generate an EDA report.

say_en.text: Explore experiment_results.csv and check for missing values
say_en.note: Claude will inspect missingness and give summary stats.

say_en.text: Summarize basic info of cells.nd2 image
say_en.note: Claude will read metadata and report dimensions and channels.
